description: Third year of secondary English (3ème année de l'enseignement secondaire, tronc commun aux six sections): the nine modules of Activate and Perform — a review module, six topic-based learning modules on family life and the generation gap, philanthropy and solidarity, entertainment and travel, science and technology, education and working life, and ecology, plus two consolidation modules — through listening, reading, speaking and writing, with the present perfect against the simple past, the past perfect, the passive, modals and deduction, conditionals of result, relative clauses, indirect questions, comparatives and comparison of scale, and word building
